name: Anuel AA
description:
'''Emmanuel Gazmey Santiago''' (born November 26, 1992), known professionally as '''Anuel AA''', is a Puerto Rican rapper and singer. He emerged during the commercial development of [[Latin trap]] in the 2010s and has also recorded reggaeton and Latin hip hop. His music frequently draws on street life, relationships and his imprisonment, while incorporating samples and [[Interpolation (popular music)|interpolations]] of earlier hip hop, reggaeton and popular songs.

Gazmey began recording as a teenager and initially distributed his music online. He later signed with the Latin division of [[Rick Ross]]'s [[Maybach Music Group]] and released the mixtape ''Real Hasta la Muerte'' in 2016. His career was interrupted that year when he was arrested on federal firearms charges and later sentenced to 30 months in prison. While incarcerated, he continued recording vocals and completed material for his debut studio album.

His debut album, ''[[Real Hasta la Muerte]]'', was released on July 17, 2018, the day of his release from federal custody. It topped the US [[Billboard Top Latin Albums|Top Latin Albums]] chart and was included in ''[[Rolling Stone]]''{{'}}s list of the best Latin albums of 2018. He subsequently appeared on commercially successful recordings including "[[Bebe (6ix9ine song)|Bebe]]", "[[Ella Quiere Beber]]", "[[Secreto (song)|Secreto]]", "[[China (Anuel AA song)|China]]" and "[[Me Gusta (Shakira and Anuel AA song)|Me Gusta]]".

Anuel AA released the double album ''[[Emmanuel (album)|Emmanuel]]'' in 2020, followed by the collaborative album ''[[Los Dioses]]'' with [[Ozuna]] in 2021. His later studio albums are ''[[Las Leyendas Nunca Mueren]]'' (2021) and ''[[LLNM2]]'' (2022). He operates the label [[Real Hasta la Muerte (record label)|Real Hasta la Muerte]]; in 2019, he entered a global distribution agreement with [[The Orchard (company)|The Orchard]].
